versos.hebraico: אָדָ֥ם שֵׁ֖ת אֱנֽוֹשׁ׃

controles.web: Adam, Seth, Enosh,
controles.kjv: Adam, Sheth, Enosh,
controles.livre: Adão, Sete, Enos,

versos.hebraico: קֵינָ֥ן מַהֲלַלְאֵ֖ל יָֽרֶד׃

controles.web: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,
controles.kjv: Kenan, Mahalaleel, Jered,
controles.livre: Cainã, Maalalel, Jarede,

versos.hebraico: חֲנ֥וֹךְ מְתוּשֶׁ֖לַח לָֽמֶךְ׃

controles.web: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,
controles.kjv: Henoch, Methuselah, Lamech,
controles.livre: Enoque, Matusalém, Lameque,

versos.hebraico: נֹ֥חַ שֵׁ֖ם חָ֥ם וָיָֽפֶת׃ס

controles.web: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
controles.kjv: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
controles.livre: Noé, Sem, Cam, e Jafé.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֣י יֶ֔פֶת גֹּ֣מֶר וּמָג֔וֹג וּמָדַ֖י וְיָוָ֣ן וְתֻבָ֑ל וּמֶ֖שֶׁךְ וְתִירָֽס׃ס

controles.web: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
controles.kjv: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Jafé foram: Gômer, Magogue, Dadai, Javã, Tubal, Meseque, e Tiras.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֖י גֹּ֑מֶר אַשְׁכֲּנַ֥ז וְדִיפַ֖ת וְתוֹגַרְמָֽה׃

controles.web: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, and Diphath, and Togarmah.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Gomer; Ashchenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Gômer: Asquenaz, Rifate, e Togarma.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֥י יָוָ֖ן אֱלִישָׁ֣ה וְתַרְשִׁ֑ישָׁה כִּתִּ֖ים וְרוֹדָנִֽים׃ס

controles.web: The sons of Javan: Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Javã: Elisá, Társis, Quitim, e Dodanim.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֖י חָ֑ם כּ֥וּשׁ וּמִצְרַ֖יִם פּ֥וּט וּכְנָֽעַן׃

controles.web: The sons of Ham: Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
controles.kjv: The sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Cam: Cuxe, Misraim, Pute, e Canaã.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֣י כ֔וּשׁ סְבָא֙ וַחֲוִילָ֔ה וְסַבְתָּ֥א וְרַעְמָ֖א וְסַבְתְּכָ֑א וּבְנֵ֥י רַעְמָ֖א שְׁבָ֥א וּדְדָֽן׃ס

controles.web: The sons of Cush: Seba, and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raama, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba, and Dedan.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raamah, and Sabtecha. And the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Cuxe: Sebá, Havilá, Sabtá, Raamá, e Sabtecá. E os filhos de Raamá foram: Sebá e Dedã.

versos.hebraico: וְכ֖וּשׁ יָלַ֣ד אֶת־נִמְר֑וֹד ה֣וּא הֵחֵ֔ל לִהְי֥וֹת גִּבּ֖וֹר בָּאָֽרֶץ׃ס

controles.web: Cush became the father of Nimrod; he began to be a mighty one in the earth.
controles.kjv: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be mighty upon the earth.
controles.livre: E Cuxe gerou a Ninrode: este começou a ser poderoso na terra.

versos.hebraico: וּמִצְרַ֡יִם יָלַ֞ד אֶת־לודיים וְאֶת־עֲנָמִ֛ים וְאֶת־לְהָבִ֖ים וְאֶת־נַפְתֻּחִֽים׃

controles.web: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
controles.kjv: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
controles.livre: Misraim gerou aos ludeus, aos ananeus, aos leabeus, aos leabeus, aos naftueus,

versos.hebraico: וְֽאֶת־פַּתְרֻסִ֞ים וְאֶת־כַּסְלֻחִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצְא֥וּ מִשָּׁ֛ם פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וְאֶת־כַּפְתֹּרִֽים׃ס

controles.web: and Pathrusim, and Casluhim (where the Philistines came from), and Caphtorim.
controles.kjv: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (of whom came the Philistines,) and Caphthorim.
controles.livre: Aos patrusitas, e aos casluítas (destes saíram os Filisteus), e os caftoreus.

versos.hebraico: וּכְנַ֗עַן יָלַ֛ד אֶת־צִיד֥וֹן בְּכֹר֖וֹ וְאֶת־חֵֽת׃

controles.web: Canaan became the father of Sidon his firstborn, and Heth,
controles.kjv: And Canaan begat Zidon his firstborn, and Heth,
controles.livre: E Canaã gerou a Sidom, seu primogênito; e a Hete;

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הַיְבוּסִי֙ וְאֶת־הָ֣אֱמֹרִ֔י וְאֵ֖ת הַגִּרְגָּשִֽׁי׃

controles.web: and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,
controles.kjv: The Jebusite also, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,
controles.livre: E aos jebuseus, aos amorreus, aos girgaseus;

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הַחִוִּ֥י וְאֶת־הַֽעַרְקִ֖י וְאֶת־הַסִּינִֽי׃

controles.web: and the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
controles.kjv: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
controles.livre: Aos heveus, aos arqueus, ao sineus;

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הָאַרְוָדִ֥י וְאֶת־הַצְּמָרִ֖י וְאֶת־הַֽחֲמָתִֽי׃ס

controles.web: and the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.
controles.kjv: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.
controles.livre: Aos arvadeus, aos zemareus, e aos hamateus.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֣י שֵׁ֔ם עֵילָ֣ם וְאַשּׁ֔וּר וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁ֖ד וְל֣וּד וַאֲרָ֑ם וְע֥וּץ וְח֖וּל וְגֶ֥תֶר וָמֶֽשֶׁךְ׃ס

controles.web: The sons of Shem: Elam, and Asshur, and Arpachshad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.
controles.kjv: The sons of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Sem foram: Elão, Assur, Arfaxade, Lude, Arã, Uz, Hul, Geter, e Meseque.

versos.hebraico: וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁ֖ד יָלַ֣ד אֶת־שָׁ֑לַח וְשֶׁ֖לַח יָלַ֥ד אֶת־עֵֽבֶר׃

controles.web: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah, and Shelah became the father of Eber.
controles.kjv: And Arphaxad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.
controles.livre: Arfaxade gerou a Selá, e Selá gerou a Héber.

versos.hebraico: וּלְעֵ֥בֶר יֻלַּ֖ד שְׁנֵ֣י בָנִ֑ים שֵׁ֣ם הָאֶחָ֞ד פֶּ֗לֶג כִּ֤י בְיָמָיו֙ נִפְלְגָ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ וְשֵׁ֥ם אָחִ֖יו יָקְטָֽן׃

controles.web: To Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.
controles.kjv: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; because in his days the earth was divided: and his brother’s name was Joktan.
controles.livre: E a Héber nasceram dois filhos: o nome do um foi Pelegue, pois em seus dias a terra foi dividida; e o nome de seu irmão foi Joctã.

versos.hebraico: וְיָקְטָ֣ן יָלַ֔ד אֶת־אַלְמוֹדָ֖ד וְאֶת־שָׁ֑לֶף וְאֶת־חֲצַרְמָ֖וֶת וְאֶת־יָֽרַח׃

controles.web: Joktan became the father of Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
controles.kjv: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
controles.livre: E Joctã gerou a Almodá, Salefe, Hazarmavé, e Jerá,

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הֲדוֹרָ֥ם וְאֶת־אוּזָ֖ל וְאֶת־דִּקְלָֽה׃

controles.web: and Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,
controles.kjv: Hadoram also, and Uzal, and Diklah,
controles.livre: E a Adorão, Uzal, Dicla,

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־עֵיבָ֥ל וְאֶת־אֲבִימָאֵ֖ל וְאֶת־שְׁבָֽא׃

controles.web: and Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
controles.kjv: And Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
controles.livre: Ebal, Abimael, Sebá,

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־אוֹפִ֥יר וְאֶת־חֲוִילָ֖ה וְאֶת־יוֹבָ֑ב כָּל־אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י יָקְטָֽן׃ס

controles.web: and Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
controles.kjv: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
controles.livre: Ofir, Havilá, e a Jobabe: todos filhos de Joctã.

controles.web: Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah,
controles.kjv: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,
controles.livre: Sem, Arfaxade, Selá,

versos.hebraico: עֵ֥בֶר פֶּ֖לֶג רְעֽוּ׃

controles.web: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
controles.kjv: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
controles.livre: Héber, Pelegue, Reú,

versos.hebraico: שְׂר֥וּג נָח֖וֹר תָּֽרַח׃

controles.web: Serug, Nahor, Terah,
controles.kjv: Serug, Nahor, Terah,
controles.livre: Serugue, Naor, Terá,

versos.hebraico: אַבְרָ֖ם ה֥וּא אַבְרָהָֽם׃ס

controles.web: Abram (the same is Abraham).
controles.kjv: Abram; the same is Abraham.
controles.livre: E Abrão, o qual é Abraão.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵי֙ אַבְרָהָ֔ם יִצְחָ֖ק וְיִשְׁמָעֵֽאל׃ס

controles.web: The sons of Abraham: Isaac, and Ishmael.
controles.kjv: The sons of Abraham; Isaac, and Ishmael.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Abraão foram: Isaque e Ismael.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֖לֶּה תֹּלְדוֹתָ֑ם בְּכ֤וֹר יִשְׁמָעֵאל֙ נְבָי֔וֹת וְקֵדָ֥ר וְאַדְבְּאֵ֖ל וּמִבְשָֽׂם׃

controles.web: These are their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
controles.kjv: These are their generations: The firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
controles.livre: E estas são suas gerações: o primogênito de Ismael foi Nebaiote; depois Quedar, Adbeel, Mibsão,

versos.hebraico: מִשְׁמָ֣ע וְדוּמָ֔ה מַשָּׂ֖א חֲדַ֥ד וְתֵימָֽא׃

controles.web: Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,
controles.kjv: Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,
controles.livre: Misma, Dumá, Massá, Hadade, Temá,

versos.hebraico: יְט֥וּר נָפִ֖ישׁ וָקֵ֑דְמָה אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֖ם בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׁמָעֵֽאל׃ס

controles.web: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
controles.kjv: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
controles.livre: Jetur, Nafis, e Quedemá. Estes foram os filhos de Ismael.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֨י קְטוּרָ֜ה פִּילֶ֣גֶשׁ אַבְרָהָ֗ם יָלְדָ֞ה אֶת־זִמְרָ֧ן וְיָקְשָׁ֛ן וּמְדָ֥ן וּמִדְיָ֖ן וְיִשְׁבָּ֣ק וְשׁ֑וּחַ וּבְנֵ֥י יָקְשָׁ֖ן שְׁבָ֥א וּדְדָֽן׃ס

controles.web: The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba, and Dedan.
controles.kjv: Now the sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bare Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan; Sheba, and Dedan.
controles.livre: Quanto aos filhos de Quetura, concubina de Abraão, esta deu à luz Zinrã, Jocsã, Medã, Midiã, Isbaque, e a Suá. Os filhos de Jobsã: Sebá e Dedã.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֣י מִדְיָ֗ן עֵיפָ֤ה וָעֵ֨פֶר֙ וַחֲנ֔וֹךְ וַאֲבִידָ֖ע וְאֶלְדָּעָ֑ה כָּל־אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י קְטוּרָֽה׃ס

controles.web: The sons of Midian: Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these are the sons of Keturah.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Midiã: Efá, Efer, Enoque, Abida, e Elda; todos estes foram filhos de Quetura.

versos.hebraico: וַיּ֥וֹלֶד אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֶת־יִצְחָ֑קס בְּנֵ֣י יִצְחָ֔ק עֵשָׂ֖ו וְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

controles.web: Abraham became the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau, and Israel.
controles.kjv: And Abraham begat Isaac. The sons of Isaac; Esau and Israel.
controles.livre: E Abraão gerou a Isaque: e os filhos de Isaque foram Esaú e Israel.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֖י עֵשָׂ֑ו אֱלִיפַ֛ז רְעוּאֵ֥ל וִיע֖וּשׁ וְיַעְלָ֥ם וְקֹֽרַח׃ס

controles.web: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jalam, and Korah.
controles.kjv: The sons of Esau; Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Esaú: Elifaz, Reuel, Jeús, Jalão, e Corá.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֖י אֱלִיפָ֑ז תֵּימָ֤ן וְאוֹמָר֙ צְפִ֣י וְגַעְתָּ֔ם קְנַ֖ז וְתִמְנָ֥ע וַעֲמָלֵֽק׃ס

controles.web: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.
controles.kjv: The sons of Eliphaz; Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Elifaz: Temã, Omar, Zefi, Gatã, Quenaz, Timna, e Amaleque.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֖י רְעוּאֵ֑ל נַ֥חַת זֶ֖רַח שַׁמָּ֥ה וּמִזָּֽה׃ס

controles.web: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
controles.kjv: The sons of Reuel; Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Reuel: Naate, Zerá, Samá, e Mizá.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֣י שֵׂעִ֔יר לוֹטָ֥ן וְשׁוֹבָ֖ל וְצִבְע֣וֹן וַֽעֲנָ֑ה וְדִישֹׁ֥ן וְאֵ֖צֶר וְדִישָֽׁן׃

controles.web: The sons of Seir: Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Seir; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Seir: Lotã, Sobal, Zibeão, Ana, Disom, Eser, e Disã.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֥י לוֹטָ֖ן חֹרִ֣י וְהוֹמָ֑ם וַאֲח֥וֹת לוֹטָ֖ן תִּמְנָֽע׃ס

controles.web: The sons of Lotan: Hori, and Homam; and Timna was Lotan’s sister.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Lotan; Hori, and Homam: and Timna was Lotan’s sister.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Lotã: Hori, e Homã: e Timna foi irmã de Lotã.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֣י שׁוֹבָ֔ל עַלְיָ֧ן וּמָנַ֛חַת וְעֵיבָ֖ל שְׁפִ֣י וְאוֹנָ֑םס וּבְנֵ֥י צִבְע֖וֹן אַיָּ֥ה וַעֲנָֽה׃

controles.web: The sons of Shobal: Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah, and Anah.
controles.kjv: The sons of Shobal; Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon; Aiah, and Anah.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Sobal: Aliã, Manaate, Ebal, Sefi e Onã. Os filhos de Zibeão foram: Aiá, e Aná.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֥י עֲנָ֖ה דִּישׁ֑וֹןס וּבְנֵ֣י דִישׁ֔וֹן חַמְרָ֥ן וְאֶשְׁבָּ֖ן וְיִתְרָ֥ן וּכְרָֽן׃ס

controles.web: The sons of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hamran, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
controles.kjv: The sons of Anah; Dishon. And the sons of Dishon; Amram, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
controles.livre: Disom foi filho de Aná: e os filhos de Disom foram Hanrão, Esbã, Itrã e Querã.

versos.hebraico: בְּֽנֵי־אֵ֔צֶר בִּלְהָ֥ן וְזַעֲוָ֖ן יַעֲקָ֑ן בְּנֵ֥י דִישׁ֖וֹן ע֥וּץ וַאֲרָֽן׃פ

controles.web: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, and Zaavan, Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz, and Aran.
controles.kjv: The sons of Ezer; Bilhan, and Zavan, and Jakan. The sons of Dishan; Uz, and Aran.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Eser foram: Bilã, Zaavã, e Jaacã. Os filhos de Disã: Uz e Arã.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֣לֶּה הַמְּלָכִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר מָלְכוּ֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֱד֔וֹם לִפְנֵ֥י מְלָךְ־מֶ֖לֶךְ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בֶּ֚לַע בֶּן־בְּע֔וֹר וְשֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖וֹ דִּנְהָֽבָה׃

controles.web: Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
controles.kjv: Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the children of Israel; Bela the son of Beor: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
controles.livre: E estes são os reis que reinaram na terra de Edom, antes que reinasse algum rei sobre os filhos de Israel: Belá, filho de Beor; e o nome de sua cidade era Dinabá.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֖מָת בָּ֑לַע וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו יוֹבָ֥ב בֶּן־זֶ֖רַח מִבָּצְרָֽה׃

controles.web: Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.
controles.kjv: And when Bela was dead, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
controles.livre: Belá morreu, e reinou em seu lugar Jobabe, filho de Zerá, de Bozra.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֖מָת יוֹבָ֑ב וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו חוּשָׁ֖ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ הַתֵּימָנִֽי׃

controles.web: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
controles.kjv: And when Jobab was dead, Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.
controles.livre: Jobabe morreu, e reinou em seu lugar Husão, da terra dos Temanitas.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֖מָת חוּשָׁ֑ם וַיִּמְלֹ֨ךְ תַּחְתָּ֜יו הֲדַ֣ד בֶּן־בְּדַ֗ד הַמַּכֶּ֤ה אֶת־מִדְיָן֙ בִּשְׂדֵ֣ה מוֹאָ֔ב וְשֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖וֹ עיות׃

controles.web: Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Avith.
controles.kjv: And when Husham was dead, Hadad the son of Bedad, which smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.
controles.livre: Husão morreu, e reinou em seu lugar Hadade, filho de Bedade, o qual feriu aos midianitas no campo de Moabe; e o nome de sua cidade era Avite.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֖מָת הֲדָ֑ד וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו שַׂמְלָ֖ה מִמַּשְׂרֵקָֽה׃

controles.web: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
controles.kjv: And when Hadad was dead, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
controles.livre: Hadade morreu, e reinou em seu lugar Sanlá, de Masreca.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֖מָת שַׂמְלָ֑ה וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו שָׁא֖וּל מֵרְחֹב֥וֹת הַנָּהָֽר׃

controles.web: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his place.
controles.kjv: And when Samlah was dead, Shaul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.
controles.livre: Sanlá morreu, e reinou em seu lugar Saul de Reobote, que está junto ao rio.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֖מָת שָׁא֑וּל וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו בַּ֥עַל חָנָ֖ן בֶּן־עַכְבּֽוֹר׃

controles.web: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.
controles.kjv: And when Shaul was dead, Baal–hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
controles.livre: E Saul morreu, e reinou em seu lugar Baal-Hanã, filho de Acbor.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֨מָת֙ בַּ֣עַל חָנָ֔ן וַיִּמְלֹ֤ךְ תַּחְתָּיו֙ הֲדַ֔ד וְשֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖וֹ פָּ֑עִי וְשֵׁ֨ם אִשְׁתּ֤וֹ מְהֵיטַבְאֵל֙ בַּת־מַטְרֵ֔ד בַּ֖ת מֵ֥י זָהָֽב׃

controles.web: Baal Hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Pai: and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
controles.kjv: And when Baal–hanan was dead, Hadad reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pai; and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
controles.livre: E Baal-Hanã morreu, e reinou em seu lugar Hadade, cuja cidade tinha por nome Paí; e o nome de sua mulher era Meetabel, filha de Matrede, a filha de Mezaabe.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֖מָת הֲדָ֑דס וַיִּהְיוּ֙ אַלּוּפֵ֣י אֱד֔וֹם אַלּ֥וּף תִּמְנָ֛ע אַלּ֥וּף עליה אַלּ֥וּף יְתֵֽת׃

controles.web: Hadad died. The chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,
controles.kjv: Hadad died also. And the dukes of Edom were; duke Timnah, duke Aliah, duke Jetheth,
controles.livre: Hadade morreu. E os príncipes em Edom foram: o príncipe Timna, o príncipe Aliá, o príncipe Jetete,

versos.hebraico: אַלּ֧וּף אָהֳלִיבָמָ֛ה אַלּ֥וּף אֵלָ֖ה אַלּ֥וּף פִּינֹֽן׃

controles.web: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,
controles.kjv: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,
controles.livre: O príncipe Oolibama, o príncipe Elá, o príncipe Pinom,

versos.hebraico: אַלּ֥וּף קְנַ֛ז אַלּ֥וּף תֵּימָ֖ן אַלּ֣וּף מִבְצָֽר׃

controles.web: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,
controles.kjv: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,
controles.livre: O príncipe Quenaz, o príncipe Temã, o príncipe Mibzar,

versos.hebraico: אַלּ֥וּף מַגְדִּיאֵ֖ל אַלּ֣וּף עִירָ֑ם אֵ֖לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֥י אֱדֽוֹם׃פ

controles.web: chief Magdiel, chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.
controles.kjv: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram. These are the dukes of Edom.
controles.livre: O príncipe Magdiel, o príncipe Irã. Estes foram os príncipe de Edom.
